symbols.name: ResultProblemDetailsSchemaTransformer
symbols.summary: An OpenAPI schema transformer that configures Result problem detail schemas.
symbols.remarks: This transformer modifies the OpenAPI schema for BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.ResultProblemDetails, BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.ResultProblemData, BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.ResultProblemError, and BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.ProblemError to enhance their documentation and explicitly allow arbitrary additional properties. For each matching schema, this transformer: Adds comprehensive descriptions to all objects and their propertiesSets the schema type to "object"Sets additionalPropertiesAllowed to trueGenerates "additionalProperties": {} in the OpenAPI JSON for RFC 7807 compliance This is essential for RFC 7807 problem details that include extension data and custom error information. Each distinct schema type is logged only once during the build-time document generation process.

symbols.summary: Transforms OpenAPI schemas for Result problem detail types.
